testflight.whats_new: The first build of King Walk for iPhone and iPad. Please try: solving a few puzzles (tap or drag), a hint, a wrong move, Share, the Game Center button in the menu, the widget (home screen and Lock Screen), dark mode, and progress syncing to a second device. Menu > Haptics turns haptics off.

note: First TestFlight build. Runs once the App Store Connect secrets are set (ios/README.md, One-time setup); change this note to run it again.
